mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 34 degrees out near Badger Prairie County Park with a Waning Crescent moon phase visible.

The City of Verona is reviewing several pending projects, including a site plan and traffic impact analysis for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, which will be discussed at the December 7th Plan Commission meeting.

We have a busy schedule with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard happening today, followed by music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's tomorrow, and the Dane County Farmer's Market taking over the Capitol Square tomorrow as well.
In a report from the Verona Police Department, officers responded to a call on October 25th where a man was arrested for his first O W I offence after being found behind the wheel at an intersection.
It is a great day to grab a scoop, and our local Culver's will be opening today at 10:00 AM with the delicious Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day.
